cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Immutable f4ebc43 report/table_forces.tex:10 supplies final Cd1.0949/Cl-0.0025 and St0.160; figs_re200.tex:4,8,48 references residual, force and wake figures. The original force figure shows late lift but its shared full-history scale does not resolve late drag oscillations, and no alternate late-force zoom is referenced; score2 retained under the Re200 display floor. Workspace force CSV SHA256 82e8f42b5a387b2c70daa6fb359b6236fe8626165b498f68e931ae5b01f8cc31 yields t>=200 mean Cd1.09323, Cl -0.15578..0.16170, dominant FFT frequency0.159984 and four 25-unit Cl RMS 0.10957/0.11006/0.11063/0.11096. Raw zero crossings are contaminated by high-frequency fluctuations, so no period is inferred from them. driver.cpp:586–641 checks the full BDF residual with predictor-frozen limiter and records that ratio; strict fully refreshed-limiter target behavior is not established, and report discloses freezing. Exact historical executable remains unbound; no unsteady rerun.
